# Control sweep (practice): every checkbox and spinner of the Options, Audio, Advanced and Realism pages clicked once
# Generated by scripts/gen-controls-tours.py from tour_options_practice.txt. CHANGES SETTINGS in the running game (the profile is written on exit):
# run only through scripts/gtr2-control-check.py, which launches the game for this tour alone, compares the profile and reverts it.
# Needs:  gtr2-nav.py path --setting-step FILE
# Format: PAGE | LABEL | EXPECTED PAGE   ('!CONTROLS' clicks every control of the page shown)

OPTIONS_BASIC_SUMMARY | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_BASIC_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_BASIC_SUMMARY | VIDEO | OPTIONS_DETAIL_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_DETAIL_SUMMARY | AUDIO | OPTIONS_AUDIO_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_AUDIO_SUMMARY | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_AUDIO_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_AUDIO_SUMMARY | ADVANCED | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SUMMARY | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SUMMARY | REALISM | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SUMMARY | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SUMMARY
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SUMMARY | CONTROLS | CONTROL_KEYS_SUMMARY
CONTROL_KEYS_SUMMARY | ADVANCED | CONTROL_ONE_SUMMARY
CONTROL_ONE_SUMMARY | FORCE | CONTROL_FORCE_SUMMARY
CONTROL_FORCE_SUMMARY | BACK | MAIN MENU
